Game Overview

Infinite Bird is a arcade game built around guide a lively bird skyward through an ever-changing log landscape. Test your reflexes and timing as you glide horizontally, ensuring each jump leads to safety. Simple yet thrilling, this endless challenge will keep you soaring higher and vying for perfection. Your flight to fun awaits—take the leap!
